title: Grateful Dead Live at Moscone Convention Center on 1982-05-28
source: SBD: It's from a Pat Lee reel, Dick Latvala gave it to him. Maybe MC>R @3 3/4ips??  Maybe one more gen; Transfer info: Akai GX636 direct tape head output > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/ a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960 > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC; Tranfered June 2014 by Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Warm, well‑meshed soundboard capture of a laid‑back benefit set featuring standout Walkin' Blues with guest Cipollina despite minor mic glitches.
ai_review.review: The one‑off May 28, 1982 Bay Area benefit delivers an hour‑and‑a‑half of tight rock and blues that feels organically synchronized, highlighted by Cipollina’s psych‑laden contribution on Walkin' Blues. The soundboard source is generally clear and warm, though a high‑pitched spook in Alabama Getaway and occasional drops on Jerry’s vocal mic are noticeable.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers praise the musical tightness and unique guest appearance, while noting a few recording glitches; with only one detailed review confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally warm and clear soundboard mix; minor issues include a high‑pitched spook in Alabama Getaway and intermittent loss of Jerry's vocal mic.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Single benefit set focused on rock and blues without typical jam vehicles, delivering a smooth, organic flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocal mic drops at points, but guitar tone blends well with the overall warm mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Warm, meshing tones contribute to the organic feel of the set (Brent era keyboards).
